scenarios.title: Download scan report for an event with recorded scans
given: an event exists with recorded badge scan entries (e.g. event ID EVENT123)
scenarios.when: the user requests the scan report for the event (e.g. GET /report/EVENT123)
then: a downloadable report document containing the scan records for the specified event is received
the report contents include the details of each recorded badge scan

scenarios.title: Download scan report for an event with no recorded scans
given: an event exists with no recorded badge scan entries (e.g. event ID EVENTEMPTY)
scenarios.when: the user requests the scan report for the empty event (e.g. GET /report/EVENTEMPTY)
then: a report document is received indicating that no scan records are present

scenarios.title: Request scan report for a non-existent event
given: no event exists matching the requested identifier (e.g. event ID NONEXISTENT999)
scenarios.when: the user requests the scan report for the unknown event (e.g. GET /report/NONEXISTENT999)
then: the request is rejected with an indication that the event or report was not found

scenarios.title: Ensure scan report contains only scans belonging to the requested event
given: two distinct events exist each having their own badge scan entries (e.g. EVENTA and EVENTB)
scenarios.when: the user requests the scan report for the first event (e.g. GET /report/EVENTA)
then: the report contains only the scans recorded for the requested event
no scan records belonging to the other event (e.g. EVENTB) appear in the report

scenarios.title: Preserve all entries and ordering for an event with multiple scans
given: an event exists with multiple badge scans recorded sequentially (e.g. event ID EVENTMULTI)
scenarios.when: the user requests the scan report for the event
then: all recorded scan entries are present in the report
the sequential or chronological order of the recorded scans is preserved in the report data

scenarios.title: Request scan report for an expired or purged event
given: an event existed whose scan data has been expired or purged
scenarios.when: the user requests the scan report for the expired event (e.g. GET /report/EXPIRED123)
then: the user is informed that the event report is no longer available or not found

scenarios.title: Request scan report with an invalid or malformed event identifier
given: an invalid event identifier containing unsupported path characters or traversal attempts (e.g. ../invalid)
scenarios.when: the user requests the scan report using the invalid identifier
then: the request is rejected with an error or not found indication
no unintended files or system resources are exposed

scenarios.title: Request scan report without providing an event identifier
given: the report endpoint is accessed without specifying an event identifier
scenarios.when: the report request is submitted without an identifier parameter
then: the request is rejected or redirected with an indication that a valid event identifier is required
